arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# OLS Regression: Fiscal Year (x) vs Total Financing (y)
# Data from Table FFO-1, column (20) Total Financing, in millions of dollars

x = [2010, 2011, 2012]
y = [1293454, 1295591, 1089353]  # in millions

# Calculate OLS slope and intercept
# slope = sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)**2)
# intercept = ybar - slope*xbar

n = len(x)
xbar = sum(x) / n
ybar = sum(y) / n

numerator = sum((xi - xbar) * (yi - ybar) for xi, yi in zip(x, y))
denominator = sum((xi - xbar) ** 2 for xi in x)

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"x = {x}")
print(f"y = {y}")
print(f"xbar = {xbar}")
print(f"ybar = {ybar}")
print(f"slope = {slope}")
print(f"intercept = {intercept}")

# Predict for FY 2013
x_2013 = 2013
y_pred_2013 = intercept + slope * x_2013

print(f"\nPredicted Total Financing for FY 2013: {y_pred_2013}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(y_pred_2013, 2)}")
EOF
